versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֞י מִקֵּ֣ץ׀ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֧ה שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־בֵּיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built Yahweh’s house, and his own house,
controles.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the Lord, and his own house,
controles.livre: E aconteceu que ao fim de vinte anos que Salomão havia edificado a casa do SENHOR e sua casa,

versos.hebraico: וְהֶעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן חוּרָם֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֹתָ֑ם וַיּ֥וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֖ם אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
controles.kjv: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
controles.livre: Reedificou Salomão as cidades que Hirão lhe havia dado, e estabeleceu nelas aos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ חֲמָ֣ת צוֹבָ֔ה וַיֶּחֱזַ֖ק עָלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.
controles.kjv: And Solomon went to Hamath–zobah, and prevailed against it.
controles.livre: Depois veio Salomão a Hamate de Zobá, e a tomou.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֥בֶן אֶת־תַּדְמֹ֖ר בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְאֵת֙ כָּל־עָרֵ֣י הַֽמִּסְכְּנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּחֲמָֽת׃

controles.web: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.
controles.kjv: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
controles.livre: E edificou a Tadmor no deserto, e todas as cidades de armazéns que edificou em Hamate.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֜בֶן אֶת־בֵּ֤ית חוֹרוֹן֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית חוֹר֖וֹן הַתַּחְתּ֑וֹן עָרֵ֣י מָצ֔וֹר חוֹמ֖וֹת דְּלָתַ֥יִם וּבְרִֽיחַ׃

controles.web: Also he built Beth Horon the upper, and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
controles.kjv: Also he built Beth–horon the upper, and Beth–horon the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
controles.livre: Assim reedificou a Bete-Horom a de acima, e a Bete-Horom a de abaixo, cidades fortificadas, de muros, portas, e barras;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶֽת־בַּעֲלָ֗ת וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־עָרֵ֤י הַֽמִּסְכְּנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְאֵת֙ כָּל־עָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְאֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַפָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשַׁק֙ לִבְנ֤וֹת בִּירֽוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וּבַלְּבָנ֔וֹן וּבְכֹ֖ל אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, and the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
controles.kjv: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
controles.livre: E a Baalate, e a todas as vilas de armazéns que Salomão tinha; também todas as cidades dos carros e as de cavaleiros; e tudo o que Salomão quis edificar em Jerusalém, e no Líbano, e em toda a terra de seu senhorio.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הָ֠עָם הַנּוֹתָ֨ר מִן־הַחִתִּ֜י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֤י וְהַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְהַחִוִּ֣י וְהַיְבוּסִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹ֥א מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה׃

controles.web: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel;
controles.kjv: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,
controles.livre: E a todo o povo que havia restado dos heteus, amorreus, perizeus, heveus, e Jebuseos, que não eram de Israel,

versos.hebraico: מִן־בְּנֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נוֹתְר֤וּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־כִלּ֖וּם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲלֵ֤ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְמַ֔ס עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn’t consume, of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day.
controles.kjv: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
controles.livre: Os filhos dos que haviam restado na terra depois deles, aos quais os filhos de Israel não destruíram do todo, fez Salomão tributários até hoje.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־בְּנֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־נָתַ֧ן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה לַעֲבָדִ֖ים לִמְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ כִּי־הֵ֜מָּה אַנְשֵׁ֤י מִלְחָמָה֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י שָׁלִישָׁ֔יו וְשָׂרֵ֥י רִכְבּ֖וֹ וּפָרָשָֽׁיו׃פ

controles.web: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.
controles.kjv: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Israel não pôs Salomão servos em sua obra; porque eram homens de guerra, e seus príncipes e seus capitães, e comandantes de seus carros, e seus cavaleiros.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שָׂרֵ֤י הנציבים אֲשֶׁר־לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם הָרֹדִ֖ים בָּעָֽם׃

controles.web: These were the chief officers of king Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.
controles.kjv: And these were the chief of king Solomon’s officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
controles.livre: E tinha Salomão duzentos e cinquenta principais dos governadores, os quais mandavam naquela gente.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹ֗ה הֶעֱלָ֤ה שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מֵעִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד לַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽנָה־לָ֑הּ כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר לֹא־תֵשֵׁ֨ב אִשָּׁ֥ה לִי֙ בְּבֵית֙ דָּוִ֣יד מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּי־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁר־בָּֽאָ֥ה אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David to the house that he had built for her; for he said, “My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where Yahweh’s ark has come are holy.”
controles.kjv: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the Lord hath come.
controles.livre: E passou Salomão à filha de Faraó, da cidade de Davi à casa que ele lhe havia edificado; porque disse: Minha mulher não morará na casa de Davi rei de Israel, porque aquelas habitações de onde entrou a arca do SENHOR, são sagradas.

versos.hebraico: אָ֣ז הֶעֱלָ֧ה שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה עֹל֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה עַ֚ל מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָאוּלָֽם׃

controles.web: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of Yahweh, which he had built before the porch,
controles.kjv: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the Lord on the altar of the Lord, which he had built before the porch,
controles.livre: Então ofereceu Salomão holocaustos ao SENHOR sobre o altar do SENHOR, que havia ele edificado diante do pórtico,

versos.hebraico: וּבִדְבַר־י֣וֹם בְּי֗וֹם לְהַעֲלוֹת֙ כְּמִצְוַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה לַשַּׁבָּתוֹת֙ וְלֶ֣חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וְלַמּ֣וֹעֲד֔וֹת שָׁל֥וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה בְּחַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַשָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the Sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times in the year, in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tents.
controles.kjv: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
controles.livre: Para que oferecessem cada coisa em seu dia, conforme ao mandamento de Moisés, nos sábados, nas novas luas, e nas solenidades, três vezes no ano, a saber, na festa dos pães ázimos, na festa das semanas, e na festa das cabanas.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד כְּמִשְׁפַּ֣ט דָּֽוִיד־אָ֠בִיו אֶת־מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים עַל־עֲבֹדָתָ֗ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם עַל־מִ֠שְׁמְרוֹתָם לְהַלֵּ֨ל וּלְשָׁרֵ֜ת נֶ֤גֶד הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לִדְבַר־י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֔וֹ וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֥ים בְּמַחְלְקוֹתָ֖ם לְשַׁ֣עַר וָשָׁ֑עַר כִּ֣י כֵ֔ן מִצְוַ֖ת דָּוִ֥יד אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise, and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required; the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
controles.kjv: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
controles.livre: E constituiu as repartições dos sacerdotes em seus ofícios, conforme à ordenação de Davi seu pai; e os levitas por suas ordens, para que louvassem e ministrassem diante dos sacerdotes, casa coisa em seu dia; assim os porteiros por sua ordem

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֣א סָרוּ֩ מִצְוַ֨ת הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ עַל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֛ם לְכָל־דָּבָ֖ר וְלָאֹצָרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
controles.kjv: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
controles.livre: E não saíram do mandamento do rei, quanto aos sacerdotes e levitas, e os tesouros, e todo negócio:

versos.hebraico: וַתִּכֹּן֙ כָּל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַד־הַיּ֛וֹם מוּסַ֥ד בֵּית־יְהוָ֖ה וְעַד־כְּלֹת֑וֹ שָׁלֵ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared to the day of the foundation of Yahweh’s house, and until it was finished. So Yahweh’s house was completed.
controles.kjv: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the Lord, and until it was finished. So the house of the Lord was perfected.
controles.livre: Porque toda a obra de Salomão estava preparada desde o dia em que a casa do SENHOR foi fundada até que se acabou, até que a casa do SENHOR foi acabada do tudo.

versos.hebraico: אָז֩ הָלַ֨ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה לְעֶצְיֽוֹן־גֶּ֧בֶר וְאֶל־אֵיל֛וֹת עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת הַיָּ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Then went Solomon to Ezion Geber, and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.
controles.kjv: Then went Solomon to Ezion–geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
controles.livre: Então Salomão foi a Eziom-Geber, e a Elote, à costa do mar na terra de Edom.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽשְׁלַֽח־לוֹ֩ חוּרָ֨ם בְּיַד־עֲבָדָ֜יו אוניות וַעֲבָדִים֮ י֣וֹדְעֵי יָם֒ וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ עִם־עַבְדֵ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אוֹפִ֔ירָה וַיִּקְח֣וּ מִשָּׁ֔ם אַרְבַּע־מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים כִּכַּ֣ר זָהָ֑ב וַיָּבִ֖יאוּ אֶל־הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃פ

controles.web: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and fetched from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
controles.kjv: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
controles.livre: Porque Hirão lhe havia enviado navios por mão de seus servos, e marinheiros destros no mar, os quais foram com os servos de Salomão a Ofir, e tomaram de ali quatrocentos e cinquenta talentos de ouro, e os trouxeram ao rei Salomão.
